description: Run kyb_check on up to 25 companies at once and get one compact row per company (status, insolvency, sanctions, debts, verdict). Use for supplier lists or portfolios. Each company counts as one API request against your rate limit. Requires an authenticated account.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the register (e.g. SK, CZ, AT, PL). Strongly recommended: registry numbers are NOT unique across countries (an SK and a CZ company can share the same 8-digit IČO), and without it the server picks one by tie-break.

ico.description: National registry identifier (SK/CZ IČO, AT Firmenbuch number, PL KRS/REGON, FR SIREN, …). Leading zeros are normalised server-side.

name: screen_companies

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying check.

title: Screen a list of companies
